verdict.rationale: Synthesia's API quickstart documents configuring a webhook that Synthesia calls when a video completes successfully, instead of polling. That is a registrable outbound HTTP callback a programmatic consumer can receive. Only a single event (video completion) is evidenced, with no detail on how registration works. Missing for 10: an event catalog beyond video completion, webhook registration/management API details, payload signing/verification and retry semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
